title: The 12 Layers of the AI Boom
subtitle: Explained in 90 seconds

scenes.narration: The trillions of dollars flowing through artificial intelligence pass through twelve distinct layers — most of which you have never heard of.

scenes.label: Spent on AI infrastructure
scenes.caption: in 2024 alone
scenes.narration: Last year, the world spent over two hundred billion dollars building out the infrastructure behind AI.

scenes.heading: The Stack
scenes.narration: From sand to software, every layer adds value. Some are open markets. Some are choke points dominated by a single company.

scenes.label: Per ASML EUV machine
scenes.caption: Only one company makes them
scenes.narration: Take layer one. ASML in the Netherlands is the only company on Earth that builds the EUV lithography machines required for advanced AI chips.

scenes.heading: The Designers
scenes.narration: And the chip designers — the brains. NVIDIA still leads, but Google, Apple, Amazon, and others are racing to build their own.

scenes.heading: AI Energy Demand
scenes.narration: But the real bottleneck of the next five years is not chips. It is electricity. By 2030, AI is projected to consume roughly Japan's entire annual power supply.

scenes.heading: The Frontier Labs
scenes.narration: On top sits the visible part — the foundation labs you have heard of. Six contenders, one prize.

scenes.fact: 9 out of 10 publicly traded AI infrastructure companies are headquartered in just 4 countries.
scenes.narration: Nine out of ten of these companies are headquartered in just four countries: the United States, Taiwan, Korea, and the Netherlands.
